name: MaxMind
summary: GeoIP2 and free GeoLite web services: country, city-level geolocation and, with Insights, ISP, connection type, user type and anonymizer (VPN, proxy, Tor, hosting) data for an IP.

account_id.description: Your MaxMind account ID (maxmind.com account portal); the HTTP Basic username.

license_key.description: A MaxMind license key (account portal > Manage License Keys); the HTTP Basic password. A GeoLite account's key works on the geolite endpoints only.

notes: GeoIP2 calls spend prepaid service credits (402 INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS when they run out); the response's maxmind.queries_remaining shows the approximate balance. GeoLite calls are free with a daily query limit, and the same 402 means that limit is reached.
Use 'me' as the IP to look up the caller's own address. Reserved or private addresses return 400 IP_ADDRESS_RESERVED; an address not in the data returns 404.
Many error responses in a row can get the account rate-limited (429).

endpoints.name: Get an IP's country (GeoIP2 Country)
endpoints.summary: Country, registered and represented country, continent and traits for an IP.

endpoints.name: Geolocate an IP to city level (GeoIP2 City Plus)
endpoints.summary: City, postal code, subdivisions, coordinates, time zone, country, continent and traits for an IP.

endpoints.name: Get an IP's full profile (GeoIP2 Insights)
endpoints.summary: Everything in City Plus plus connection type, user type, ISP, mobile codes, confidence scores and the anonymizer object (VPN, public and residential proxy, Tor exit, hosting provider, provider name).
notes: Anonymizer flags appear only when true; a missing key means false.

endpoints.name: Get an IP's country (free GeoLite)
endpoints.summary: Free country-level lookup on the GeoLite web service.

endpoints.name: Geolocate an IP to city level (free GeoLite)
endpoints.summary: Free city-level lookup on the GeoLite web service; no queries_remaining field.
